claims.claim: Container drums, water storage drums, plastic barrel, plastic drum
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows several large blue plastic drums with hinged swing-top lids, consistent with water storage/container drums.
No kegs (smaller barrel-type containers) are visible in the reported photo; only large blue drums are shown.
Witness explicitly describes the items as plastic with ribbed design and plastic swing-top lids; no metal or steel construction is mentioned or visible.

risks.proof: Photo showing embossed liter markings or a tape measure against the drum height/diameter
risks.if_unproven: price as smallest common capacity for this drum style

risks.risk: Cracks, stress fractures, or UV degradation not visible at this distance
risks.proof: Close-up photos of drum walls, especially near the ribbing and base
risks.if_unproven: price as cosmetically worn, functionally unverified

risks.risk: Lid seal/locking ring may be damaged or missing
risks.proof: Video or photo of the swing-top lid being closed and latched

risks.risk: Unknown previous contents (chemical residue, odor, food-grade status)
risks.proof: Seller statement with photo of any original content label, or interior photo
Photo looking inside an open drum

risks.risk: Exact number of drums for sale is unclear
risks.proof: Wide shot counting all units included in the sale, or seller itemized list
risks.if_unproven: price per single drum, worst case count of one

risks.proof: Photo of a cut edge or spec sheet showing wall thickness

proof_requests: Clear unwatermarked photo of all drums together, counted
Close-up of drum walls and base for cracks or UV wear
Photo/video of lid closing and latching
Interior photo of an open drum
Any capacity markings or measurement with a tape
Clarification on whether any steel/metal drums are actually included
response.reason: Witness confirms the items are plastic storage drums, so a worst-case price can be set; several seller claims (kegs, steel) are unverifiable or contradicted and should not raise the price until proven.
